review: LuCI invokes rpcd session.login only with supplied username/password; issues cookie only after successful session reply.
Lua filters incoming FORWARDED CGI headers and injects session SID/token loaded locally from rpcd.
Go globally revalidates root identity and token in rpcd, no session auth cache.
RPCD configured root password references shadow; shadow contains a password hash, not an empty password.
LuCI cookie Secure on HTTPS, HttpOnly and SameSite=strict; logout destroys rpcd session.
No production uhttpd restart, firewall or password change was performed.
